verdicts.meshy: a 182,555-triangle head mesh with a 4096² skin texture, a 478-landmark eye projection and twelve ARKit keys; the face is one closed surface
verdicts.cc0: a 57,232-triangle parametric head with painted vertex-colour features; four of seven measured landmarks inside tolerance
verdicts.photographs: the reference face: oval, high cheekbones, tapered jaw, full lips, winged liner, defined cupid's bow
verdicts.reason: the Meshy head is the only geometry that carries her features at all; the concise evidence is the two face close-ups side by side — the CC0 build paints brows and lips as blobs, the Meshy head carries them as texture and geometry
verdicts.correction: keep; the correction that belongs here is texture resolution on the nose and chin, not new geometry

verdicts.meshy: hair starts at the measured hairline with baby hairs across the forehead; the hairline shape is part of the texture and the hair mass
verdicts.cc0: measured 52.38 mm above the eye line against the photographs' 87.68 mm (-35.3 mm) — the bald forehead visible in the render
verdicts.photographs: 87.68 mm above the eye line, centre part, dense curls framing the face
verdicts.reason: this is the defect the CC0 pass could not fix and the Meshy asset does not have: its hair begins on the measured hairline instead of 35 mm below it

verdicts.meshy: two separate eye-patch meshes (1,026 triangles each) with their own materials and 12 shared blink/wide keys; iris, liner and lashes are painted at 4096²
verdicts.cc0: a bright sclera and a small dark iris; the lid aperture reads as a doll's eye
verdicts.photographs: almond eyes, warm brown iris, winged liner, long lashes, slightly upturned outer corners
verdicts.reason: the Meshy eyes are the same eye patches the app already blinks; nothing in the CC0 build is better
verdicts.correction: the eye patches can be rebuilt independently — they are already separate primitives with their own materials

verdicts.meshy: head is a separate 182k mesh joined at the choker line; 1.719 m total height with the rig's own head bone
verdicts.cc0: head measured against her landmarks: interpupillary 61.75 mm (ref 63), jaw 98.65 mm (ref 96)
verdicts.reason: the Meshy head is right in identity and the CC0 head is right in a few measured proportions; a scale/translation pass on the Meshy head is cheaper and safer than rebuilding identity from the CC0 head
verdicts.correction: fit the Meshy head to the measured interpupillary distance and jaw width; re-measure after the fit, do not assume it

verdicts.meshy: 39,166-triangle body, 1.719 m, 24 joints, A-pose, the body the app's 31 clips animate
verdicts.cc0: 1.29 M triangle parametric body with a wider A-pose and no rig
verdicts.photographs: her build, shoulder and hip widths from the specification sheets
verdicts.reason: the Meshy body is the one the animations were authored for; replacing it would invalidate every clip

verdicts.meshy: a fitted outfit (top, cargo trousers, boots, choker) with baked PBR textures at 2048²/4096²
verdicts.cc0: a fitted corset with a painted motif and loose cap-sleeve loops that read as detached geometry
verdicts.photographs: her cargo silhouette, choker, boots and jewellery in the look sheets
verdicts.reason: the Meshy outfit is coherent, textured and attached to the rig; the CC0 garment reads as paint over polygons
verdicts.correction: clothing is fused into the body primitive; separating it is the WP05 separation task, not a rebuild

verdicts.meshy: septum ring, hoops, rose headpiece with the quartz jewel, chain and rings — geometry plus texture, visible in the close-up
verdicts.cc0: a thin wire inside the hair that reads as a dark line, plus procedural body pieces
verdicts.photographs: rose-quartz jewel at the hairline, crystal drop between the brows, septum ring, large hoops
verdicts.reason: the CC0 jewellery is the weakest part of that build; the Meshy asset already has the pieces the photographs show

verdicts.meshy: 24 joints, 36 morph-target entries over 3 meshes, 31 external clips authored against this rig
verdicts.cc0: no armature and no shape keys
verdicts.reason: one rig, one identity: the animations and the app's expression system target this skeleton

verdicts.meshy: 6 primitives / 224233 triangles: body 39166, head 182555, two eye patches, mouth 368, teeth 92
verdicts.cc0: 15 named components, already separable, but the identity is wrong
verdicts.reason: the head and eyes are already separate; hair, clothing and skin share the body and head primitives, so those are the ones that need a separation pass before they can be controlled independently
verdicts.correction: separate hair / clothing / skin within the body and head meshes while preserving the original file and the head's shape keys

verdicts.meshy: not needed for scaffold: the rig exists
verdicts.cc0: the parametric anatomy with measured landmark targets
